text:
rachel: Quick ping — PR #534 adds a tiny 'Optimize quickstart' subsection showing batching + quant profile. Need a fast docs pass and a 3-item migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood/optimize/pull/534
tom: Can we keep snippets runnable? prefer 6–10 lines max per language. Also add a one-line cost heuristic.
anya: Minimal Python example (v2 SDK) that shows batching + kv prefetch:```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key='${REDWOOD}')
outs = client.batch.text.generate([{ 'model':'redwood/opt-x', 'prompt':'Summarize logs' },{ 'model':'redwood/opt-x', 'prompt':'List errors' }], options={ 'kv_prefetch': True })
for o in outs: print(o.text)
```
kevin: Compact quant profile suggestion (YAML) to include in docs:```yaml
precision: q8_0
kv_prefetch: true
shortseq_policy:
  max_tokens: 14
  fallback_precision: float32
```
Add a one-line note: "Start with q8_0; if you see degraded short-prompt accuracy, use the shortseq fallback."
rachel: Good. Also add a tiny Node example that demonstrates client.batch():```js
const { Client } = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD })
const res = await client.batch.text.generate([ { model: 'redwood/opt-x', prompt: 'Summarize logs' }, { model: 'redwood/opt-x', prompt: 'List errors' } ], { kv_prefetch: true })
res.forEach(r => console.log(r.outputText))
```
tom: For the PR description let's include a 3-line checklist: 1) update SDK examples to v2 batch/text, 2) add quant YAML with shortseq fallback, 3) attach a 10-prompt smoke eval (float32 vs q8_0) with token/cost delta.
kevin: I'll add a suggested tiny smoke eval result format in PR comments: a 3-row table showing total tokens, avg latency, approximate cost for float32 vs q8_0.
rachel: Can someone run the smoke eval and paste numbers before we merge? small table is fine.
anya: I'll run 10 prompts and post the numbers by EOD.
release-bot: label applied: docs/needs-review
rachel: Once merged, release-bot please publish a brief changelog line and ping #release-war-room with the checklist attached.
release-bot: will post changelog and notify #release-war-room on merge.
